prompt: Many people with physical disabilities find it difficult to travel for pleasure, even within their own country. What problems do they face, and what measures could be taken to make travel easier for them?
essay:
Nowadays travelling is very popular, and it is important for everybody because it helps people to relax and learn new things. However, for the people with physical disabilities it is still very difficult to travel, even inside their own country. In this essay I will discuss the main problems they face and suggest some solutions for them.

The first problem is the transport. Many buses and trains do not have ramps or lifts, so a person in a wheelchair can not get on them easily. Also, the stations are often very old and there are many stairs. Another problem is the hotels and the tourist places. Many hotels say on their website that they have accessible rooms, but when the person arrive, the bathroom is too small or there is a step at the door. Moreover, travelling is very expensive for disabled people, because they often need a helper and they have to pay for two persons.

There are several solutions for these problems. Firstly, the government should make a law that all the new buses and trains must have ramps and all the stations must have lifts. Secondly, the hotels should give the correct information on their websites, and there should be a inspection to check it. Thirdly, the government can give some discount for the helper, so the cost of the travel will be less. Finally, the staff in airports and hotels should get training about how to help disabled people in a good way.

In conclusion, disabled people face many problems when they travel, such as the transport, the hotels and the cost. If the government and the companies work together, these problems can be solved and everybody can enjoy the travelling like the other people.
title: Travel for people with disabilities
